result.title: InterBand-EMG: A Cross-Band Foundation Model for Generalizable Hand-Pose Estimation
result.summary: Surface electromyography (sEMG) enables continuous hand-pose estimation, but learning representations that generalize across users and movements remains challenging. We introduce InterBand-EMG, which combines band-specific quantization with cross-band reconstruction and structured masked code prediction to learn transferable EMG representations for hand-pose tracking. We also introduce SynapMyo, an eight-channel EMG-to-pose dataset comprising 1,227.74 hand-hours from 499 users across 68 movement categories. Experiments on emg2pose and SynapMyo show that InterBand-EMG outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in joint-angle accuracy across all three generalization settings on both datasets. The source code and the SynapMyo dataset will be publicly released upon acceptance of this paper.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出跨频带 sEMG 基础模型 InterBand-EMG，结合频带特定量化、跨频带重建与结构化掩码码预测学习可迁移表示，用于连续手部姿态估计，并发布八通道 EMG-姿态数据集 SynapMyo。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「频带量化 + 跨带重建 + 掩码码预测」可能为 latent 推理状态的离散码本设计与片段级监督提供参考，但任务本身与 VLM 推理无直接联系，需核查掩码结构与码本是否具迁移价值。
